title: Pycaso CMO — Step 4: SE(3) arm alignment & final 26p model
description: Telecentric + SE(3) fitting, ablation, autopsy, PCA, corner BA refinement.
license: See StereoComplex and Pycaso repository licenses.

settings.title: CMO microscope
settings.description: Common Main Objective stereo microscope used in the Pycaso open dataset. The StereoComplex case study treats the left and right channels as two effective off-axis CMO sub-apertures. Raw image folders are external and expected under examples/pycaso_data after cloning Pycaso.

settings.title: Stereo rig
settings.description: Stereo rig defined by the measured rayfield. The stereo angle and baseline are read from the constrained Zernike O(0)+d(2) rayfield. The final compact physical model is a telecentric CMO model with a per-arm SE(3) correction (26 parameters, 1.06 px RMS, P50=0.87 px, P95=1.84 px).

data_sources.title: SE(3) aligned CMO fit
data_sources.model: CMO telecentric + SE(3) per arm, 26 parameters

data_sets.title: Arm alignment
data_sets.description: Global line-bundle alignment sweep showing the 14x improvement from telecentric L0 to SE(3)-aligned CMO.

data_sets.title: 26p fit result
data_sets.description: Final joint fit parameters for the telecentric CMO + per-arm SE(3) 26-parameter model.

data_sets.title: SE(3) ablation
data_sets.description: Ablation of rotation-only, translation-only, full per-arm SE(3), shared rotation, shared translation and differential-only variants.

data_sets.title: 20p autopsy
data_sets.description: Negative control showing that the differential-only 20p model is too constrained.

data_sets.title: 26p autopsy
data_sets.description: Residual analysis and compression tests for the final 26p compact physical model.

data_sets.title: PCA residual
data_sets.description: PCA analysis showing that remaining residuals are spatially varying and require flexible rayfield parameterisation.
